class.name: GifExporter
class.brief_description: Compatibility API for incrementally building animated GIF files.
class.description: [GifExporter] preserves the legacy [method begin_export], [method write_frame], and [method end_export] workflow while using the modern GIF module internally. Frame delays use GIF hundredths of a second. Images are converted to RGBA8, composited over the supplied background color, quantized to the requested bit depth, and optionally Floyd-Steinberg dithered. Call [method end_export] to observe write errors. Destroying an active exporter attempts to finish it for compatibility, but cannot report failure.

method.name: begin_export
method.description: Starts an export to [param file_path]. [param frame_delay] is the default delay in hundredths of a second, [param loop_count] is [code]0[/code] for infinite looping, and [param bit_depth] must be from [code]1[/code] to [code]8[/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] for invalid arguments or if an export is already active.

method.name: end_export
method.description: Writes all buffered frames and finishes the active export. Returns [code]false[/code] if no export is active, no frames were added, or the file cannot be written. A failed write remains active so it can be retried.

method.name: write_frame
method.description: Buffers [param frame] using [param frame_delay] in hundredths of a second. A delay of [code]0[/code] uses the default passed to [method begin_export]. The image must match the export dimensions. Alpha is composited over [param background_color].
